platform_admin.label: Platform Administrator
platform_admin.description: Full system access across all organizations. Can manage platform settings, users, and all organizational data.

user.label: User
user.description: Standard platform user with organization-specific permissions.

owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Full control over the organization. Can manage all settings, members, facilities, bookings, and billing.

admin.label: Administrator
admin.description: Administrative access to the organization. Can manage members, facilities, bookings, and most settings.

saksbehandler.label: Case Handler
saksbehandler.description: Case handler with permissions to manage bookings, customer requests, and operational tasks.

redaktør.label: Editor
redaktør.description: Editor with permissions to manage content, facilities, and availability. Cannot access sensitive data or billing.

staff.label: Staff Member
staff.description: Operational access to manage facilities, bookings, and availability. Cannot modify organization settings or billing.

lesetilgang.label: Read-Only Access
lesetilgang.description: Read-only access to view facilities, bookings, and reports. Cannot make modifications.

customer.label: Customer
customer.description: Standard customer access. Can view facilities, create bookings, and manage own profile.

messages.insufficientRole: You don't have sufficient permissions for this action
messages.ownerOnly: Only the owner has access to this feature

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.description: View detailed reports and statistics for the organization

advancedBooking.name: Advanced Booking
advancedBooking.description: Access to advanced booking features like recurring bookings and bulk reservations

bulkOperations.name: Bulk Operations
bulkOperations.description: Perform bulk actions on multiple items at once

apiAccess.name: API Access
apiAccess.description: Access to API for integrations and automation

auditLogs.name: Audit Logs
auditLogs.description: View detailed log of all actions in the system

facilityManagement.name: Facility Management
facilityManagement.description: Full control over facilities and their settings
